column1: # Responsibility-specific limits moved unchanged from the component contract.
# These are exact paths, not basename/glob exemptions from size checks.
# Lexical statement control and hidden zone-resource cleanup share one owner.
# Known/Unproven transfer, structured joins and payload admission share truth.
# Existing statement/assignment artifact issuers each have an explicit 600 cap.
# One renderer owns the stable diagnostic reason/fix vocabulary.
# Composite intent admission and LLVM projection remain distinct bounded owners.
# Receiver identity is one authority; the separate family aggregate stays 1250.
# Grown past the 600 stage default while the bootstrap red hid this gate;
# pinned at the closure checkpoint size until each owner is split.
